  def initialize(packer: nil)
    @packer = packer
    @store = {}
  end

  def write(key, payload, stale: false)
    data = { payload: payload, stale: stale }
    if @packer
      stored = @packer.dump(data)
    else
      stored = data
    end
    @store[key] = stored
    payload
  end

  def read(key)
    return nil unless @store.key?(key)
    
    stored = @store[key]
    if @packer
      data = @packer.load(stored)
    else
      data = stored
    end

    # But actually, read should return the payload regardless of stale status
    # unless it was removed. Let me re-read the requirements.

    # So read should return the payload even if stale: true was passed.
    # sweep removes entries where stale: true was passed.
    # So read returns the payload regardless.
    
    data[:payload]
  end

  def sweep
    keys_to_remove = []
    @store.each do |key, stored|
      if @packer
        data = @packer.load(stored)
      else
        data = stored
      end
      
      if data[:stale]
        keys_to_remove << key
      end
    end
    
    keys_to_remove.each do |key|
      @store.delete(key)
    end
  end
end
